verdict.rationale: Rippling documents its own bulk capabilities in benefits administration. Uploading a carrier EOI file matches decisions to employees, updates coverage, and adjusts payroll deductions in bulk, and it can automatically approve dependents and route EOI in bulk. This evidence is confined to one domain and does not show general-purpose bulk editing across HR, IT, or payroll records, nor bulk operations through an API or AI-driven interface. Missing for 10: general bulk edit/update across arbitrary records, bulk operations via API/CLI or AI agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.
